title: DeepSeek, DeepThink!
statementMd:
Recently, Colin found that DeepSeek is such a useful AI that he can always give it problems he meets and receive lots of good suggestions, especially when Colin turns on the DeepThink option: DeepSeek will show the procedure of thinking, and it makes everything look so clear and convincing!

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/85567164d3450655b905b3f8c974b3413057ff77.png)

Although DeepSeek's thinking procedure does look like a human's, Colin found a phenomenon that always starts with, "Okay, so I want to figure out how to..."

Colin wants to build an extraordinary AI by himself: ColinSeek, but since Colin knows too little about AI, he decides to start by imitating. Now, please help Colin write the very first code for the ColinThink option of ColinSeek:

When the user asks in the format **How to xxx?**, show the thinking procedure as **Okay, so I want to figure out how to xxx.** The last part (xxx) is the same as the user's question.

## Input

A single line represents the user's question. The input is guaranteed to start with "`How to `"  and end with "`?`". The input between these two parts consists of lower English letters, digits, and blank spaces. Except for the two sample inputs, the length of the input line (excluding the line ending) is larger than 1024 bytes and less than 16384 bytes.

## Output

Output the thinking procedure of ColinSeek, as described in the description.
statementZhMd:
最近，Colin 发现 DeepSeek 是一个非常实用的 AI。他总能把遇到的问题交给它，并获得许多好建议，尤其是在 Colin 开启 DeepThink 选项之后：DeepSeek 会展示思考过程，让一切看起来都那么清晰、令人信服！

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/85567164d3450655b905b3f8c974b3413057ff77.png)

虽然 DeepSeek 的思考过程看起来确实很像人类，但 Colin 发现了一个现象：它总是以“Okay, so I want to figure out how to...”开头。

Colin 想自己打造一个非凡的 AI：ColinSeek。但由于 Colin 对 AI 知之甚少，他决定从模仿开始。现在，请帮助 Colin 为 ColinSeek 的 ColinThink 选项编写最初的代码：

当用户以 **How to xxx?** 的格式提问时，以 **Okay, so I want to figure out how to xxx.** 的格式展示思考过程。最后一部分（xxx）与用户问题中的对应部分相同。

## 输入格式

一行，表示用户的问题。保证输入以“`How to `”开头，以“`?`”结尾。这两部分之间的内容由小写英文字母、数字和空格组成。除两个样例输入外，输入行的长度（不含行结束符）大于 1024 字节且小于 16384 字节。

## 输出格式

按照题目描述，输出 ColinSeek 的思考过程。

samples.input: How to win the champion of gxcpc?
samples.output: Okay, so I want to figure out how to win the champion of gxcpc.
Okay, so I want to figure out how to solve these 13 questions .
